title: Knotty by Nature Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Check out the stunning renovation at Knotty by Nature, located just six houses from the beach on Savannah Street in Seaside, Florida.
description_expanded: Description60 SAVANNAH STREET2 KINGS, 1 QUEEN-OVER-QUEEN BUNK Premier Seaside Retreat with a Private PoolLooking for a premier Seaside home with a private pool? Knotty by Nature delivers a rare and refined coastal experience just six houses from the beach on Savannah Street in Seaside, Florida. This beautifully renovated, single-story home has undergone an extensive transformation featuring all-new designer furnishings, a fully modernized gourmet kitchen, and completely renovated bathrooms throughout.Thoughtfully reimagined with both relaxation and entertaining in mind, Knotty by Nature offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and location in one of Seaside’s most sought-after neighborhoods.Exceptional Outdoor Living & Private PoolDesigned for seamless indoor-outdoor living, Knotty by Nature showcases a large L-shaped wraparound porch ideal for morning coffee, afternoon lounging, or evening gatherings. The porch features a stunning outdoor lounge area complete with a flat-screen Smart TV, creating an inviting space for coastal entertaining.Across from the lounge area, guests will find outdoor dining for four, a cozy seating nook near the front entrance, and a convenient ice maker, perfect for preparing coolers before heading to the beach. At the rear of the home, a private deck with a custom plunge pool awaits—one of the few private pools in all of Seaside—offering a secluded oasis after a day in the sun.Open-Concept Living with a Gourmet KitchenInside, the home opens to a bright, open-concept living space that seamlessly connects the living room, dining area, and kitchen. The living area features a spacious designer sectional, a wall-mounted Samsung 4K Smart TV with basic cable, and a Sonos soundbar, creating a comfortable hub for gathering.The newly renovated chef’s kitchen is both functional and stunning, anchored by a marble center island with bar seating for three. High-end appliances include a built-in Sub-Zero panel refrigerator, a Wolf four-burner gas range with center griddle, and a Bosch dishwasher—perfect for preparing meals during extended stays. Adjacent to the kitchen, a large dining table seats eight and overlooks a wall of glass windows with peaceful views of the screened porch and pool deck.Spacious Bedrooms & Thoughtful DesignKnotty by Nature comfortably accommodates families and groups with two king bedrooms and a custom-built queen-over-queen bunk room that sleeps four.The front king bedroom features porch access, custom wall storage, beadboard detailing, and a walk-in closet. This bedroom shares a beautifully renovated full bathroom with a deep soaking tub, glass-enclosed rain shower, double vanity, and cheerful blue-and-white nautical tile accents.The bunk room is a favorite for kids, offering a crisp coastal design, a mounted Smart TV, a jumbo bean bag lounge seat, and a walk-in closet.The rear king primary suite overlooks the pool and deck through double doors and serves as a serene retreat. This suite includes a large Smart TV with Sonos soundbar, a generous walk-in closet, and a renovated private bath featuring a double vanity and a glass-enclosed rain shower accessed by a sliding barn door.Additional SpaceFor larger groups, the rear guest cottage Feeling TipSea may be rented separately, sleeping an additional four guests with a king primary suite. (Pool use is reserved exclusively for Knotty by Nature guests.)The private pool may be heated for $35 per day from October 1 through May 1, maintaining a comfortable 85 degrees.* Spring, Spring Break, & Summer 5-night minimum; 3-night fall; 2-night winter. Must be 25 years to rent and sign the registration.FEATURES1,738 square feet351 feet or a 2-minute walk to private residential beach access at Savannah Pavilion; largest private beaches on 30APrivate plunge pool with patio ice makerGourmet kitchen with Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf gas range with griddle, and Bosch dishwasherTop-of-the-line Samsung 4K Smart TV with basic cableSonos soundbarBoosted WiFi system with speeds up to 500 MbpsPrivate driveway parkingPeacock Alley premium linens — fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickle ball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness center'Welcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityParking policy: Two parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo Pets allowedSTR23-001886
